112	### AD-03: Own environment protocol, shaped like Gymnasium
113	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `core`
114	- **Context:** CORE-01 needs one interface for every environment. REF-01 needs the library agent to train on the same Snake. AGENT-06 keeps library code out of the lab's agents.
115	- **Decision:** `core.Env` is a small Protocol whose `reset(seed)` returns `(obs, info)` and whose `step(actions)` returns a `StepResult` with Gymnasium's fields (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info), plus `frame()` for replay. AD-09 sets their batch-first shape over agents. `reference` wraps one single-agent team of a `core.Env`, with every other team played by a frozen agent (AD-15), in a `gymnasium.Env` adapter.
116	- **Alternatives:** Subclass `gymnasium.Env` directly — no adapter, but every environment and the core then depend on Gymnasium. A bespoke interface unlike Gymnasium's — needs a bigger adapter and teaches a nonstandard shape.
117	- **Consequences:** Truncation (starvation or the step cap) and termination (a collision or a catch) stay separate, so learning targets bootstrap correctly on truncation. The adapter is checked with Stable-Baselines3's `check_env`.

120	### AD-04: Stable-Baselines3 DQN as the reference implementation
121	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `reference`
122	- **Context:** For Snake, REF-01–REF-03 need an established implementation trained with the same view, rewards, step budget and seeds as the compact-view neural agent; AD-10 covers the tank. The Stable-Baselines3 DQN docs (https://stable-baselines3.readthedocs.io/en/master/modules/dqn.html, read 2026-10-17) say it supports Discrete actions and Box observations, has `buffer_size`, `target_update_interval`, `exploration_fraction`, `seed` and `device`, and offers `MlpPolicy` for vector observations. The custom-environment guide (https://stable-baselines3.readthedocs.io/en/master/guide/custom_env.html, read 2026-10-17) requires a `gymnasium.Env` with `reset(seed, options) → (obs, info)` and a five-field `step`, checked by `check_env`.
123	- **Decision:** `reference` trains Stable-Baselines3 DQN with `MlpPolicy` on the compact view through the AD-03 adapter, with `device="cpu"`. Its hidden layers, learning rate, discount, batch size, memory size, target interval and exploration schedule are mapped one-to-one from the same `RunSettings` the hand-written agent uses. Its curve points come from `evaluate`, exactly as the lab's own agents' do.
124	- **Alternatives:** CleanRL's single-file DQN — very readable, but a script to copy rather than a library to call, so "matching" it blurs into copying it. RLlib — far heavier than one laptop needs.
125	- **Consequences:** Stable-Baselines3 measures exploration as a fraction of training rather than in decay steps, and updates every `train_freq` steps. The mapping fixes `train_freq=1` and `gradient_steps=1`, and sets `exploration_fraction = decay_steps / steps`. Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium are an optional install extra, so the rest of the lab never carries them.
126	- **Probe:** none — the two pages above settle the spaces, parameters and environment interface. No account or plan is involved.

130	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `reference`

23	def train_reference(settings: RunSettings, *, root: Path = Path("runs")) -> RunRecord:
24	    """Train Stable-Baselines3 on `settings` with `device="cpu"`, into a run folder."""
25	    _check_supported(settings)

27	    adapter = OneLearnerAdapter(_env_factory(settings)())
28	    model = DQN("MlpPolicy", adapter, **dqn_kwargs(settings))

34	def _check_supported(settings: RunSettings) -> None:
35	    if settings.agent != "reference":

51	    p, e = settings.params, settings.exploration
52	    return {

56	        "buffer_size": p.memory_size,
57	        "target_update_interval": p.target_every,
58	        "learning_starts": p.learn_start,
59	        "exploration_initial_eps": e.start,
60	        "exploration_final_eps": e.end,
61	        "exploration_fraction": min(1.0, e.decay_steps / settings.steps),
62	        "train_freq": 1,
63	        "gradient_steps": 1,

71	class OneLearnerAdapter(gym.Env[np.ndarray, np.int64]):
72	    """The single agent of a one-team `core.Env` as a `gymnasium.Env` (AD-03)."""
73	
74	    def __init__(self, env: Env) -> None:
75	        team = env.teams[SOLO]
76	        self._env = env
77	        self.observation_space = gym.spaces.Box(-np.inf, np.inf, team.obs_shape, np.float32)
78	        self.action_space = gym.spaces.Discrete(team.actions.n)
79	        self.games = 0
80	
81	    def reset(
82	        self, *, seed: int | None = None, options: dict[str, Any] | None = None
83	    ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, Any]]:
84	        super().reset(seed=seed)
85	        obs, info = self._env.reset(int(self.np_random.integers(_TRAIN_SEEDS)))
86	        return obs[SOLO][0], dict(info)
87	
88	    def step(
89	        self, action: np.int64
90	    ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, SupportsFloat, bool, bool, dict[str, Any]]:
91	        result = self._env.step({SOLO: np.array([action], dtype=np.int64)})
92	        if result.terminated or result.truncated:
93	            self.games += 1
94	        reward = float(result.reward[SOLO][0])
95	        return result.obs[SOLO][0], reward, result.terminated, result.truncated, dict(result.info)

98	class ModelPlayer:
99	    """The model in training as a `core.Agent`: greedy unless exploring; it learns only in SB3."""
100	
101	    def __init__(self, model: BaseAlgorithm) -> None:
102	        self._model = model
103	
104	    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray:
105	        actions, _ = self._model.predict(obs, deterministic=not explore)
106	        return np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.int64)
107	
108	    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None:
109	        raise RuntimeError("the reference model learns only inside Stable-Baselines3")
110	
111	    def save(self, path: Path) -> None:
112	        self._model.save(path)
113	
114	    def load(self, path: Path) -> None:
115	        self._model.set_parameters(str(path))

118	class _CurveCallback(BaseCallback):
119	    """Adds a curve point from `evaluate.evaluate` at step 0, every `eval_every` and the end."""
120	
121	    def __init__(
122	        self, writer: RunWriter, settings: RunSettings, adapter: OneLearnerAdapter
123	    ) -> None:
124	        super().__init__()
125	        self._writer = writer
126	        self._settings = settings
127	        self._adapter = adapter
128	        self._started = 0.0
129	
130	    def _on_training_start(self) -> None:
131	        self._started = time.perf_counter()
132	        self._add_point()
133	
134	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
135	        if self.num_timesteps % self._settings.eval_every == 0:
136	            self._add_point()
137	        return True
138	
139	    def _on_training_end(self) -> None:
140	        if self.num_timesteps % self._settings.eval_every:
141	            self._add_point()
142	
143	    def _add_point(self) -> None:
144	        s = self._settings
145	        scores = evaluate(
146	            _env_factory(s),
147	            {SOLO: ModelPlayer(self.model)},
148	            player=s.name,
149	            train_seed=s.seed,
150	            options=EvalOptions(n_games=s.eval_games),
151	        )
152	        point = CurvePoint(
153	            step=self.num_timesteps,
154	            games=self._adapter.games,
155	            mean_score=float(np.mean(scores.scores)),
156	            elapsed_s=time.perf_counter() - self._started,
157	        )
158	        self._writer.add_point(point)

152	def _shape(fn: Callable[..., Any]) -> str:
153	    parts, starred = [], False
154	    for p in inspect.signature(fn).parameters.values():
155	        if p.name == "self":
156	            continue
157	        if p.kind is p.KEYWORD_ONLY and not starred:
158	            parts.append("*")
159	            starred = True
160	        if p.default is p.empty:
161	            parts.append(p.name)
162	        else:
163	            shown = str(p.default) if isinstance(p.default, Path) else repr(p.default)
164	            parts.append(f"{p.name}={shown}")
165	    return ", ".join(parts)
